text: Patient activation is an important aspect of self-management in type 2 diabetes (T2DM) and a key component of the Chronic Care Model, whereby patients should play an active role in their care. Past studies have yet to prove the exact factors influencing patient activation. Limited studies have examined patients’ perceptions of care and whether healthcare providers are autonomy-supportive. This study primarily focused on determining factors associated with patient activation, including sociodemographic and clinical characteristics, perception of care, and perceived autonomy support .
source_label: Patient activation among patients with type 2 diabetes and its association with perception of care, perceived autonomy support, sociodemographic and clinical characteristics
